nodes.description: LendingPool public lendingPool; main external protocol contract used for deposit/borrow/repay.
address public lendingPoolCore; approval target for USDp and PAX.
LendingPoolDataProvider public lendingPoolDataProvider; source of collateral/borrow data.
LendingPoolAddressesProvider public lendingPoolAddressesProvider; resolves fee provider and price oracle.
address public PAX; borrowed stablecoin asset address.
MockUSDC public USDp; collateral token that can be minted/burned by the pool.
uint256 public constant UINT_MAX_VALUE = uint256(-1); used as redeem-all sentinel.
Constructor validating non-zero addresses and wiring protocol references.
deposit(uint256 amount) onlyWalletOrOwner; mints, approves and deposits USDp collateral.
withdraw() onlyWalletOrOwner; redeems PToken, computes withdrawn amount and burns USDp.
borrow(uint256 amount) onlyOwner; computes needed collateral, tops up collateral and borrows PAX.
repay(uint256 amount) onlyOwner; approves PAX, repays loan then withdraws/burns collateral.
Modifier restricting caller to the contract itself or the owner.
Caller-controlled address used by onlyWalletOrOwner and onlyOwner checks.
Mint of USDp collateral without an explicit access restriction at the token level.
ERC20 approve of lendingPoolCore; front-runnable approval / reset race.
External call into lendingPool.deposit(address(USDp), amount, 0).
External call PToken(PTokenAddress).redeem(UINT_MAX_VALUE) executed before balance accounting.
Burn of redeemed USDp collateral held by the pool.
External call lendingPool.borrow(PAX, amount, 1, 0) that moves funds out after collateral setup.
External call lendingPool.repay(PAX, amount, invoicePool) paying back the loan.
ERC20 approve of PAX to lendingPoolCore inside repay.
External call through lendingPoolAddressesProvider.getFeeProvider() to price the origination fee.
External oracle price read via lendingPoolAddressesProvider.getPriceOracle().
External calls returning user collateral/borrow data and required collateral in ETH.
address(uint160(address(this))) narrowing conversion used to build the payable invoicePool receiver.
Constructor parameter for the USDp collateral token address.
Constructor parameter for the PAX borrowed asset address.
Constructor parameter for the LendingPool address.
Constructor parameter for the lending pool core address.
Collateral amount argument of deposit(uint256 amount).
Borrow amount argument of borrow(uint256 amount).
Repayment amount argument of repay(uint256 amount).
PToken address returned by lendingPool.getReserveData used as redeem target.
USDp balance of the contract captured before redeem.
USDp balance of the contract captured after redeem.
currentBalance.sub(previousBalance); amount burned after redeem.
Origination fee returned by the fee provider.
User total collateral in ETH from calculateUserGlobalData.
User total borrow balance in ETH from calculateUserGlobalData.
User total fees in ETH from calculateUserGlobalData.
User current loan-to-value from calculateUserGlobalData.
Collateral required in ETH returned by calculateCollateralNeededInETH.
Price oracle instance resolved from the addresses provider.
10**USDp.decimals(); token unit scaling factor.
Oracle price of the USDp reserve.
Collateral amount computed from ETH requirement, price and token unit.
payable address of this contract used as repay receiver.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against address(this)/owner() to gate the modifier.
onlyWalletOrOwner guards deposit; an owner or self-call bypasses external restrictions.
onlyWalletOrOwner guards withdraw; privileged caller can drain/burn collateral.
borrow is reachable only through the onlyOwner check on msg.sender.
repay is reachable only through the onlyOwner check on msg.sender.
borrow internally re-enters the public deposit function to top up collateral.
repay internally calls withdraw() after repayment.
repay performs the PAX approve to the lending pool core.
borrow performs the lendingPool.borrow external call.
_USDpToken is cast to MockUSDC and stored in USDp.
_PAXToken is assigned to the PAX state variable.
_lendingPool is cast to LendingPool and stored in lendingPool.
_lendingPoolCore initializes lendingPoolCore.
lendingPoolDataProvider is read from lendingPool.dataProvider.
lendingPoolAddressesProvider is read from lendingPool.addressesProvider.
deposit amount drives the USDp mint of the missing balance.
USDp is the token whose mint function is invoked.
deposit amount is the approval value for lendingPoolCore.
lendingPoolCore is the approve spender.
USDp is the token being approved.
deposit amount is forwarded to lendingPool.deposit.
address(USDp) is the reserve passed to lendingPool.deposit.
lendingPool is the callee of the deposit external call.
getReserveData result supplies the PToken address used for redeem.
UINT_MAX_VALUE is passed as the redeem amount sentinel.
PTokenAddress determines which PToken contract is redeemed from.
USDp.balanceOf supplies the pre-redeem balance snapshot.
USDp.balanceOf supplies the post-redeem balance snapshot.
withdrawnAmount = currentBalance.sub(previousBalance); subtraction depends on prior balance state.
withdrawnAmount = currentBalance.sub(previousBalance); balance delta could underflow without SafeMath.
withdrawnAmount is the value passed to USDp.burn.
Balance is re-read after the external redeem, making the value dependent on the external call.
borrow amount is passed to the fee provider fee calculation.
addresses provider resolves the fee provider used for the external call.
lendingPoolDataProvider is the callee for user global data and collateral calculations.
calculateUserGlobalData returns the total collateral balance in ETH.
calculateUserGlobalData returns the current LTV used in later checks.
PAX is the reserve argument of calculateCollateralNeededInETH.
borrow amount contributes to the computed ETH collateral requirement.
Origination fee contributes to the computed ETH collateral requirement.
getPriceOracle resolves the oracle instance stored in the local variable.
The resolved oracle is the callee of getAssetPrice.
Oracle asset price is stored in reserveUnitPrice.
USDp.decimals() determines the token unit scale factor.
collateralToDeposit multiplies the ETH requirement by the reserve price.
collateralToDeposit divides the product by the token unit, a rounding-sensitive division.
Computed collateral amount is approved to lendingPoolCore.
Computed collateral amount drives the USDp mint shortfall.
Computed collateral amount is passed into the internal deposit call.
borrow amount is forwarded to lendingPool.borrow.
PAX is the asset borrowed from the lending pool.
lendingPool is the callee of the borrow external call.
repay amount is the approval value for lendingPoolCore.
PAX is the token approved during repayment.
repay amount is forwarded to lendingPool.repay.
PAX is the asset repaid to the lending pool.
lendingPool is the callee of the repay external call.
repay derives the payable invoicePool receiver from address(this).
invoicePool is passed as the onBehalfOf/receiver of the repayment.
PToken.redeem is an external call made before accounting/burn, so a malicious PToken could reenter withdraw.
lendingPool.borrow is an external call executed after collateral setup; a reentrant call could repeat borrow logic.
